Fetch records from the European Investment Bank public register.

Source: R/get_assessments_eib.R
get_assessments_eib.Rd

Implementation of the explicit source "eib" for get_assessments(): get_assessments("de", source = "eib"). Backed by the EIB public register of environmental and social documents (https://www.eib.org/en/registers/) for EIB-financed projects. This is an organisation source, not a national portal: it is not in supported_countries() and not in get_assessments_coverage(); see get_assessments_sources().

Usage

get_assessments_eib(
  country,
  date_range = NULL,
  limit = Inf,
  download = FALSE,
  cache_dir = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  max_file_size_mb = NULL,
  write_sidecar = TRUE,
  refresh = FALSE,
  topic = NULL,
  relevance_threshold = NULL,
  relevance_model = NULL,
  document_type = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

country

Lowercase ISO-2 code (supplied by get_assessments()).

date_range, limit, download, cache_dir, overwrite, max_file_size_mb, write_sidecar, refresh, topic, relevance_threshold, relevance_model

See get_assessments(). date_range filters date_published.

document_type

Optional character vector of native document types, matched case-insensitively against the full label or its bracketed abbreviation (e.g. "ESIA").

...

Unused arguments are warned about.

Value

A tibble; see get_assessments() for the required schema.

Granularity and scope

One record per register document (document_id = "eib_<id>"); one project has many documents sharing project_number. ALL document types the register holds for the country are kept, with the native type label in role / native_type and one attachment_urls_<type-slug> section each. The types are not reclassified. Labels such as ESIA, Environmental Impact Assessment and SEA identify full reports (although the ESIA bucket also holds permits, decisions and placeholder rows); ESDS, ESCS and NTS are summaries. A Link to promoter website row may have no file; whether a file exists is only known after download, when a missing file is recorded as a failure in download_status. The record url is the register page. Coverage is EIB-financed projects only (publication from about 2011), not national completeness.

Geography

The register tags documents with ISO-2 country codes (plus non-ISO tags such as C7 "EU Countries" and regional A1-A9). A record matches when ANY of its tags equals the requested code (multi-country records appear under each requested country with the same document_id). Regional/non-ISO-only and untagged rows are excluded. The complete native tag list is kept in country_codes / country_labels.

Listing and completeness

One request to /provider-eib-plr/app/registers/list?countries=<ISO2> returns the whole filtered list. When the response's totalItems differs from the returned row count a planscanR_warning_partial states both numbers (the register itself shows such gaps). Per-record metadata comes from /registers/item/{id}; files from /attachments/registers/{id}.pdf. Files over max_file_size_mb are not silently dropped: they stay in the record and get skipped_size in download_status.

See also

get_assessments(), get_assessments_sources()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
get_assessments("de", source = "eib", document_type = "ESIA", limit = 5)
} # }
